changes: Login and forgot-PIN cards use border-box so width 100% includes padding.
Notification center card and rows stay inside the viewport.
Home quick actions put the icon above a horizontal title of at most two lines.
Home order is quick actions, then recent records.
Stray style tags and HTML comments are removed so later CSS parses.
Native confirm() calls go through the in-app dialog.
Screen errors are localized friendly text plus a short code. Raw errors stay on console.error.
Home clock rows redraw when myAttendance finishes or fails while home is shown, and a failed load shows one error (R7 N1).
The header entry text shrinks with an ellipsis so it never runs under the bell at 360/390 (R7 N3).
vi/th primary and secondary buttons get the same green/white roles as zh; data-role on a button wins (R7 N2).
